purpose: Required canonical traceability extension for runtime modules introduced by PR #126. This extension is enforced alongside the historical canonical registry, preserves all existing source authority, and does not substitute for the canonical BUILD-READY matrix.

code_module_records.owner_object: Tenant identity, membership, role and database-isolation runtime
code_module_records.schema: Tenant, TenantMembership, TenantInvite, TenantContext, signed tenant identity, tenant-scoped connection contracts, database-role topology checks and migrations 019 through 022
code_module_records.runtime_service: TenantAuthService, TenantRequestSecurity, PostgresTenantMembershipResolver, TenantScopedConnectionPool and tenant-partitioned service registries
code_module_records.state_machine: signed tenant and actor identity -> signature verification -> active membership resolution -> trusted TenantContext -> transaction-local tenant/actor SQL settings -> RLS -> scoped operation; malformed, untrusted, unsafe-role or cross-tenant paths fail closed
acceptance_criteria: request headers cannot assert roles or service context
signed tenant identity resolves roles from persisted membership
database sessions receive only verified tenant and actor context
runtime database roles are non-owner non-superuser non-BYPASSRLS
RLS fails cross-tenant access closed
trusted service access is PostgreSQL-role-derived
tenant mode requires durable membership authority
code_module_records.source_preservation: preserved; tenant isolation is additive and does not reclassify global control registries as tenant-owned without evidence
unresolved_gaps: legacy/global row backfill remains table-specific HOLD
production runtime-role verification remains deployment evidence
durable tenant lifecycle administration remains HOLD
